caption: Fixed-core matched-organization diagnostic for forward, natural-order, unnormalized FP64 FFT (N=65536, batch=16) on NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe. Each point is the median of seven timing trials of the complete CUDA Graph; whiskers show trial min-max, not confidence intervals or independent replicates. The cuFFT complete-library median is dashed with its trial min-max shaded. tXdY denotes X data tiles per CTA and prefetch depth Y. Both factor cores keep partition [8,8], EPT=16, columns=4, and all other mapping fields fixed within core. Explicit matched-organization mechanism diagnostic; not AUTO selection or an external provider's native organization. NativeFactor is the auditable repository register-tile implementation, not a VkFFT core transplant. cuFFT is a complete-library comparator.
scope: Explicit matched-organization mechanism diagnostic; not AUTO selection or an external provider's native organization. NativeFactor is the auditable repository register-tile implementation, not a VkFFT core transplant. cuFFT is a complete-library comparator.
spread: trial min-max; not a CI; trials are not independent replicates
paired_formula: reference median / target median; within the same core and cohort
